before.requirement: If allocation of the document URL base fails during XInclude processing, expose XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY through the XInclude context.
before.reason: The before path calls xmlXIncludeErrMemory on this allocation failure. That helper assigns XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY to ctxt->errNo, which the harness reads through xmlXIncludeGetLastError.

after.requirement: If allocation of the document URL base fails during XInclude processing, expose XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY through the XInclude context.
after.reason: The after path still handles this allocation failure, but its helper calls xmlRaiseMemoryError without an explicit errNo assignment. The delegate's implementation and a feasible input-triggered failure at this allocation are not supplied.

claims.reason: Both sides assess the same document URL base allocation failure against the same old harness. Before reporting explicitly sets the checked code; after reporting delegates it, with the delegate's effect unresolved.
missing_information: fuzz/fuzz.c::xmlFuzzMemSetup and its installed allocation callbacks
configure.ac XInclude defaults for the supplied recipe
The installed fuzz allocator callbacks and their allocation-limit behavior are needed to establish a finite input that fails the document URL base allocation.
The effect of xmlRaiseMemoryError on the XInclude context's errNo field is needed to assess the after-side harness check.
The configure.ac defaults used by the supplied build recipe are needed to confirm the static XInclude configuration.
